title: Landing commits the owner's uncommitted edits on main into its tracking commit

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-12 (slicer s451 landing): the outer session had uncommitted filings on main (s457 spec, s459 decision) awaiting the owner's commit approval; ork's landing committed them as part of "Tracking edits on main before landing s451" (f18adb3b and the merge) without asking. Wanted: commit only the landed slice's own tracking edits, and refuse or pause on other uncommitted changes on main, naming them.
